<thought>We have the molecular ion at m/z 276.07, suggesting a neutral molecular weight of ~276 Da. The M+1 intensity (~16 % of the base peak) is consistent with roughly 15 carbons (≈1.1 % per ^13C). This points toward a formula with about 15 C atoms. To narrow down the structure, I’ll obtain the ^13C NMR spectrum, which will reveal the number of distinct carbon environments and help infer functional groups.</thought>
